response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering practices, technical leadership abilities, and some relevant infrastructure experience, he has a critical disqualifying gap: the role requires 8 years of C++ programming, yet his resume shows only ~6 months of C/C++ work (December 2014–June 2015 at National Instruments). His 16-year career has been primarily in JavaScript/TypeScript and web technologies, not systems programming. Although he has worked with cloud platforms (AWS CDK, Kubernetes) and distributed systems (Dunnhumby microservices), his expertise lies in application-layer development rather than the specialized cloud compute platform infrastructure this role demands. The fundamental skill mismatch on the core technical requirement makes this a poor fit for a mid-senior technical leadership position.
strengths: Demonstrated technical leadership through Staff roles, code workshops, and creation of developer frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial) showing mentoring capability
Relevant infrastructure and distributed systems exposure including AWS CDK, Kubernetes, microservices at scale (millions of requests/second), and CI/CD pipeline management
Strong software craftsmanship foundation with proven expertise in TDD, design patterns, and establishing engineering best practices across multiple organizations
concerns: Critical gap: Only ~6 months of C++ experience against the minimum requirement of 8 years; entire career built on JavaScript/TypeScript, not systems-level programming
Career trajectory in full-stack and web development rather than specialized cloud compute infrastructure, distributed systems architecture, or systems programming domains
Limited evidence of leading large-scale infrastructure platform projects or mentoring cloud/DevOps engineering teams; most leadership experience is in application-layer development
